evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, the denylist scan still builds DIFF_OPTS without --no-renames. Git's default rename detection makes a pure rename produce a similarity/rename header with no added-line hunks, so gitleaks sees no added text for the renamed file. An attacker can add prohibited content under an exempt path, then rename it to a non-exempt path in the same PR; the content is never scanned, and the env-file/agent-local-state path rules are bypassed. Adding --no-renames in the template and regenerating the workflow makes the non-exempt path's content appear as added lines.
